archetypes.name: calibration-parity
archetypes.rationale: Live tally and committed TSV paths must stay semantically identical.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the voter agreement row construction in live plan-review/code-review tally and committed TSV ingestion. Focus on parity for accepted, rejected, neutral, missing, and single-voter cases. Check that labels and missing votes do not alter agreement denominators. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: legacy-tsv-schemas
archetypes.rationale: Historical TSV shape support is the highest compatibility risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review header-driven schema detection for 22-column design, 21-column design without body_severity, 21-column code-review, and compact 18-column code-review TSVs. Look for shifted columns, dropped v3 labels, or width-only assumptions. Verify analyzer behavior on malformed or unsupported files remains fail-soft. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: skill-harness-contract
archetypes.rationale: The new skill adds public runtime surface and a direct-run bootstrap.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /voter-calibration skill, analyzer script, docs, Makefile wiring, and shell harness as a public runtime surface. Focus on plugin-root bootstrap without CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, stdlib-only behavior, default log-root resolution, and whether the docs match the shipped CLI contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
